Description:
Behold, a knight clad in armor, commanding the king's army with unvavering determination, his presence inspiring the rallied masses trailing in his wake while striking fear into the hearts of the enemy ranks! A heavy blow of his lance shatters the enemy's defence line, clearing a path for victory. Radiating with divine energy of righteousness and bearing the standard of his allegiance, the Knight fearlessly presses forward, to victory!
Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Be it by the sword, by the shield or by the book, Knights join (or form) an order or community of like-minded individuals, and follow their calling into battle - to attack, to protect, to serve for a greater future.
Quick Note: Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warrior-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

Level 4 Creed (NOT in sequence).Creed of Vengeance: Damage + You can move through obstacles

Then.That means: each of these goes into a +2 and +4 effect
Then.Also: +5 is not valid since they loop around

Extras To Add: If you've killed such an enemy Type before..

~Formation~.Effect: Your party gains various bonuses depending on your formation!

~Free From Corruption~.Effect: If you cast this 3 times this Combat, choose an ally and remove one of their Negative Quirks.

~Advance!~.Effect: After making a weapon attack, you can make a free Movement Act for 1 meter.

~Delayed Valor~.Effect: You can store an After trigger and use it later.

~Valor Flex~.Effect: Your first Ability each Turn counts as {Teal(After)} every Act type.

~Axiom~.Effect: Roll 1d6 and convert it to Movement or Shielding.

~Perfect Form~.Effect: After you use all six Act types in a Combat, choose an Ability. It is always made with Valor this Combat and has no Cooldown.

~Honorable Duel~.Effect: Each Combat, choose an Enemy. You deal +10% Damage against eachother.

~Self-Sacrifice~.Effect:
Take 2d6 True Damage. Heal a different ally for 200% of the rolled amount.

{Teal('With Valor:')} They gain +1 Health Regen for the rest of the Adventure.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability
~Self-Sacrifice~.Notes: Can not be used on other Knights or characters with a Health Transfer Ability.

~Liberating Judgement~.Effect:
Deal 2d4 Damage to a Unit (you choose the Damage Type).

{Teal('With Valor:')} Then move a number of meters equal to the lower of the dice.
{Teal('Next:')} Damage Ability

Other Abilities Description: Choose 2 of the following Talent options.

~Row Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with +1 Damage per {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} Hits one more Unit within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.

~Cowards!~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit within 2 meters.
Give them and yourself a _shared_ 1d6 Shielding.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} The Range is 5 meters and you dash in front of it.
~Cowards!~.Upgrade: The _shared_ Shielding is automatically consumed when _either_ of you takes Damage.
~Cowards!~.Notes:
This shared Shielding has priority over other Shieldings in reducing Damage.
In ^front^ of the Unit means on the closest space in front of where they are facing.
You dash ignoring obstacles. Requires Line of Sight, and dashing requires a mostly ^clear^ path (meaning of ^clear^ up to the Quest Master).
~Cowards!~.Tips: In certain situations, you might want to target an Enemy, so you can dash closer to them!

~Platinum Storm~.Effect:
Use a weapon to deal 2d4 + 2d6 Damage on a 3x3 meter area, of the weapon's Damage Type.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Does not Damage Allies, but Heals an ally caught for one of the rolled dice.
~Platinum Storm~.Notes: Each healing d4 must be target a different Ally.

Variants.Effect: All Units you pass through are Slammed 2 meters to the side (requires a Trusted Steed).
All Units you pass through are Slowed.

~Blade of Liberation~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d8 and remove a Status Effect from them.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Then deal 200% of that die as ^weapon^ Damage to a Unit within 3 meters of you.

~Provocation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit 3 meters towards you, or 3 meters away from you.

{Teal('After Healing or being Healed*')} Daze it instead of Slamming, then gain a 1d6 Shielding.
~Provocation~.Upgrade: The {Teal('Valor*')} extra effect may trigger even if you were affected by a Heal on someone else's Turn.

~Outpost~.Effect:
Choose either a First Aid Tent or an Outpost Tower to build from scratch.
Once per Adventure, the tent can heal everyone inside for 1 Health.
While within 50km of the Tower, your party can't be ambushed, has +2 in Sight, and halves the travel time of your party.
~Outpost~.Upgrade: For smaller-scope adventures, the Quest Master can reduce the distance of the Tower to 10km.
~Outpost~.Notes: Try to build towers within 100km of eachother, and in places you may want to visit multiple times. Construct a network of such towers!

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (and tell your Ally to do so).

~Nominate Squire~.Effect:
Nominate a Hero from your party to become your _squire_ - your trusted companion and helper in your quest.

Your squire gets -2 Max Health, but you get +3 Max Health.
Whenever one of you would get a Quirk, you can choose to deny it, and be given a different Quirk that fits the situation.
~Nominate Squire~.Upgrade:
Your squire has doubled inventory capacity and you can instantly swap items from eachother with 0 Action Points (if near eachother).
They also have +2 in War Machines.

~Vows~.Requirement: Only usable in Campaigns with multiple sessions
~Vows~.Effect:
Vow on achieving a goal that would take at least 1 full Adventure.
Upon reaching your goal, you get a number of Positive Quirks equal to the number of sessions it took.
~Vows~.Upgrade: You can only have one vow at a time. Abandoning a vow gives you a Negative Quirk.

~Trusted Steed~.Effect:
You have a steed that increases your Movement Speed by 50%.
In Combat, your first Damaging Ability you use dismounts you, but deals +1d4 Damage or Slams the target 1d4 meters away.
~Trusted Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 3, your Steed can climb steep hills and jump up to 5 meters. At Level 6, it can walk on water. At Level 9, it can fly.
~Trusted Steed~.Notes: The steed can be any animal that fits the story. When dismounting, your steed runs away and disappears into the surroundings. Once per real hour, you can whistle for your steed and it will appear running toward you and you automatically mount it.

Starting Abilities Description: Playing a Knight can be challenging. If you truly can't chain together some of your Abilities, don't worry about it too much. It's all about planning in advance!

~Actions With Valor~.Effect: Your Abilities and attacks in Worthy Combat may trigger extra effects if made immediately {Teal('After')} an Act that did a certain type of _thing_.
~Actions With Valor~.Upgrade:
The previous Act can be from your previous Turn, but from before Combat.
_Protection_ means giving Shielding, absorbing Damage, etc.
Slamming or Pushing count as _Status Effects_.
~Actions With Valor~.Notes: You can take a look at the ^tags^ of an Ability to see what kind of effects it can do. The {Teal('After')} effect can only trigger if the previous Act actually did that type of ^thing^. For example, "{Teal('After')} Mass Damage" can only trigger if the previous Act did Damage to more than 1 Unit. Apply common sense, and the Quest Master has the final say for whether an {Teal('After')} can trigger.

~Challenge of Arms~.Effect:
Roll 1d8.
Gain that as a Shielding, or Heal yourself for 50% of that.
Deal that as Smash Damage to a Unit, 50% of that to Units within 3 meters of you.
Slam yourself for that, or another Unit in any diretion for 50% of that.
~Challenge of Arms~.Notes: Use this to start a chain of Abilities With Valor! When you repeat this, choose the effects again and roll dice as normal. Obviously, the repeat does not retrigger another repeat.

~Chivalric Privilege~.Effect: Pick 2 Talents from the Level 1 Core Knight set.

~Charging Stallion~.Effect:
Charge in a straight line to any location on the battlefield.
All Units you pass through _shuffle_ their positions.

{Teal('After Targeted Damage:')} Give yourself or a Unit you passed through 2 Shiedings, each equal to how many Units you passed through.
~Charging Stallion~.Upgrade: Each Shielding can go into a different Unit.
~Charging Stallion~.Notes:
Units you hit swap their positions between them _randomly_ (as chosen by the Quest Master). For example, the first Unit hit might swap positions with the last Unit hit.
Optionally, you can use this to exit the battlefield and the Combat.
Shuffling positions does not count as a Status Effect.

~Templar Retribution~.Effect:
Blind a Unit and gain 1 {Gold}Gold.
Then permanently increase the {Gold}Gold gained from this by 1d4.

{Teal('After Movement:')} Dash to the Unit, Slam it in any direction for the 1d4 rolled, and further increase the {Gold}Gold generated by 1d4.
~Templar Retribution~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Blockade~.Effect:
Use when another Unit within 2 meters would take Damage.
Gain a 1d4 Shielding and take the incoming Damage instead of that Unit.

{Teal('After Status Effect:')} After blocking the Damage with the d4, Slam the attacker the same number of meters away from you.

~Font Knight~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to cast Spells from. You have all Spells from that Font up to your Level.

Whenever you would trigger an {Teal('After')} Valor effect, you can cancel that extra effect to gain 0.5 {Mana}Mana.
~Font Knight~.Notes:
The unspent {Mana}Mana lass until the end of Combat. The {Mana}Mana can only be gained and spent in Worthy Combat.
You can change your Font and Spells inbetween Adventures.

~CATAPULT!~.Effect:
Spend 300 {Gold}Gold to craft a special Large catapult that you can take with you on your adventures!

Instead of triggering your {Teal('After')} valor effects, you can activate your catapult to give it 1 {A}Action Point.
~CATAPULT!~.Upgrade:
Anyone can push the Catapult by simply moving from behind it, without penalties.
You can spend 1 hour to spend any amount of {Gold}Gold to Heal the Catapult for 50% of that.
You can only have 1 Catapult at a time.
~CATAPULT!~.Notes:
The Catapult occupies a 2x2 meter area. The Catapult can use 1 {A}Action Point to move on its own.
The Catapult can't make Checks, and has 2/-2/0/2 in Stats, if it ever needs them.

~HURL!~.Sieger: Deals +100% Damage against Constructs and buildings!

~Stand Strong, Fellows~.Effect:
Heal either yourself, or all other Allies within 2 meters for 1d2.

{Teal('After Protection:')} Also Damages Enemies within 2 meters for 1d4 Psychic Damage.

~Ruin Lineage~.Effect:
The _strongest_ Enemy takes 3d6 Scourge or Pulse Damage, and the next strongest Enemy takes 50% of that.

{Teal('After Heal:')} Choose another Unit on the battlefield to take 50% of that.
~Ruin Lineage~.Notes:
Will only affect alive Units. ^Strongest^ is up to the Quest Master.
For each target, you can choose the Damage Type.

~Lance Unbound~.Effect:
Make a melee weapon attack that applies a ~Combo~ and has +1 Range for each {A}Action Point spent.

{Teal('After Mass Damage:')} Heal an Ally for 1 for each {A}Action Point spent.

~Creed of the Crown~.Effect:
Your first moving* Act each Turn has its distance increased by 50%.
At the end of each Turn, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 100% the number of meters you moved this Turn.
You are immune to being Slowed, Rooted, and to Hard Terrain.
~Creed of the Crown~.Upgrade: You serve the realm above all else. Your sword defends law, order, and your liege's will.
~Creed of the Crown~.Notes:
Moving* bonus accounts for Pushing or Slamming, too!
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

~Creed of the Rose~.Effect:
All your Abilities that can Heal do the {Teal(After)} effect regardless of the previous Act.
Your Abilities that can Heal that don't have an {Teal(After)} effect at all have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Creed of the Rose~.Upgrade: You are the knight of beauty and grace, a protector of the innocent, and a paragon of compassion.
~Creed of the Rose~.Notes: Healing Abilities that have an {Teal(After)} effect that doesn't Heal ^do^ trigger their {Teal(After)} effect anyway.

~Creed of the Dragon~.Effect:
You take -50% Damage from that dragon's element Type.
All your Abilities' Ranges, areas, and distances increase by 2 meters, become of the dragon's element Type, and you deal +1d4 Mass Damage*.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Upgrade: You swear your allegiance to an elder dragon you have encountered on your journey.
~Creed of the Dragon~.Notes: If an effect or Ability manages to deal Mass Damage, it deals +1d4 to all affected Units.

~Creed of Vengeance~.Requirement: Requires having been betrayed this Campaign, or having broken an oath
~Creed of Vengeance~.Effect:
You gain 2 Hatred Positive Quirks of choice.
For each die rolled with Targeted Damage, gain 0.01 Initiative and 0.05 Damage or Healing on a chosen Ability permanently.
After killing a Unit, you can move through obstacles* and enemy Units until the end of your Turn.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Upgrade: Justice has failed. Your oath was broken, your faith was betrayed, but you swore a new one: to hunt those who wronged you and make the world remember. You will bring justice, to the world and to yourself.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Notes: Obstacles* are not walls and ceilings.

~Creed of the Sun~.Effect:
You have +4 Max Health.
Whenever you inflict a non-Slam Status Effect, you can also Slam that Unit 1d6 meters away from you.
Whenever you Slam a Unit, they must choose to be Blinded, Lagged, or Frailed.
~Creed of the Sun~.Upgrade: You are the dawn that banishes despair. You ride with the light at your back and hope in your hand.
~Creed of the Sun~.Notes:
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Creed of Steel~.Effect:
You can wear 2 Shields at the time, both on the same hand.
Whenever you block some Damage with a Shielding, save the blocked amount as _Steel Points_, or give 50% of the blocked amount as a Shielding to an Ally you can see.
_Steel Points_ may last until the end of the Adventure.

~Rebuke~.Effect: {Teal('After Protection:')} Consume all _Steel Points_ to deal that much Damage of your Shield's Damage Type.
~Rebuke~.Notes: If your Shield has multiple Damage Type reductions, you can choose. If it has no Damage Type reducion, it's Smash Damage.

~No Matter What~.Effect:
At the end of your every Turn, heal for an amount equal to the Round Number.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Also heals an Ally you can see
{Teal('Next:')} TBD

~Get Up, Stand Up~.Effect:
Remove all your party members' Exhaustion (from any source).
If they were Exhausted from lack of sleep, they can resist sleep Exhaustion for 8 more hours.
~Get Up, Stand Up~.Notes: An Exhausted* Unit has -1 Action Point for each tier of Exhaustion. At Triple-Exhausted, the Unit dies.

<Fellowship Aura>.Effect:
You stand out for allies near you.
Enemy ranged attacks against other allies within 1 meter of you have Cover.
<Fellowship Aura>.Notes: Nothing happens if an ally near you already has Cover. If playing on a grid, this does work for allies diagonally.

<Banner of Honor>.Effect:
Activate and fling a Banner on a space within 5 meters, dealing 1d8 Damage to Units it lands on or next to.
Allies (and you) starting their Turn within 2 meters of the banner start with +1 Action Point.

{Teal('With Valor:')} +1000% Range and +200% Damage to Enemies
{Teal('Next:')} Any non-Damage Ability.
<Banner of Honor>.Upgrade: The banner counts as a Unit with 10 Health, but can't take Mass Damage.
<Banner of Honor>.Notes: The banner's effect only applies if it's planted into the ground. To be moved, the banner can be picked up with a 1 Action Point, and thrown again with a 1 Action Point to reposition and deal the Damage again.

<Knight in Black>.Effect:
Single-Stuns have no effect on your. Double-Stuns and Triple-Stuns only reduce your Actions by 1 and 2 (respectively).
While there are no allies within 4 meters of you, all your weapon attacks and self healing have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next dice type.
<Knight in Black>.Notes:
Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1..
While _alone_, your healing Abilities have their Dice Upgraded when healing yourself.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

<Man of Steel>.Effect: If you're wearing Heavy Armor or a Shield, you have +1 Defense and +5 Max Health.

<White Knighthood>.Effect: While at or above 35 Health and wearing white clothes, all your Abilities have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
<White Knighthood>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
